answer: The saffron index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the nectar queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 324 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the canyon. Bonded capital sits idle for 5 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
